dogecoin.text:
They’re not just focused on Bitcoin. The platform supports mining for Litecoin, Dogecoin, and Alephium, positioning users to benefit from the broader PoW ecosystem. 

As these tokens get integrated into more DeFi protocols, mining rewards could become even more valuable.

The launch includes support for Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Binance Coin, TRON, Dogecoin, Sui, and other significant digital assets, ensuring comprehensive coverage of the most actively traded cryptocurrencies in the market.
